title: Pukka Juice 5000+ Fizzy Pop 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Pukka Juice 5000+ Fizzy Pop Nic Salt e-liquid delivers a lively mix of zesty citrus fruits with a fizzy, tangy kick on the exhale. This e-liquid captures the playful essence of a fizzy soda, offering a bright, bubbly vape that’s as refreshing as it is satisfying. Designed with a 50VG/50PG ratio, Pukka Juice 5000+ Nic Salts are ideal for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices and pod systems, providing smooth throat hits and quick nicotine satisfaction. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths, Fizzy Pop offers a delightful, citrus-infused vape experience. Pukka Juice is celebrated for its vibrant e-liquid flavours. The 5000+ collection takes inspiration from disposable vape flavours, bringing them into a versatile e-liquid format for use with reusable vape devices. Explore other favourites like Lemon & Lime, Polar Mint, and Tropical.
